subject: Literature
title: Banned Books Week and the Fight Back
description: A quick win: understand Banned Books Week and the Fight Back.

hook.text: Every September, American libraries celebrate Banned Books Week by displaying and promoting books others tried to suppress.

buildup.text: The event started in 1982 after a surge in challenges to school and library materials across the country.

discovery.text: Librarians have become frontline defenders of free expression, sometimes risking their own jobs to protect access.

twist.text: Some states have passed laws threatening librarians with criminal prosecution for providing challenged books to minors.

climax.text: Banned Books Week transformed librarians from quiet custodians of books into vocal champions of intellectual freedom.

punchline.text: Librarians became the unexpected warriors for free speech.

quiz.question: What role have librarians taken in the fight against book banning?
options: They remain neutral and follow all government orders
They have become frontline defenders of free expression
They have no role in the debate over banned books
